id.description: The delivery's id; the same on every retry, so a receiver can ignore one it has had.

test.description: true for Send test; data is then an example.

data.description: The record as stored (as GET returns it); for deleted, its id, version and deletedAt.

description: What each delivery POSTs, as JSON. It's signed: X-LawFive-Signature is t=<unix seconds>,v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256 of "<t>.<body>" with the webhook's secret>.
